result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of a change of variables in the plane, using a geometric configuration with distances ρ, r, a, the ratio λ = r/ρ and an angle φ, to transform an area element ρ dρ dψ and an auxiliary quantity χ.

$a\left(\frac{1}{1+\lambda}+\frac{1}{1-\lambda}\right)$[?]
